pending.title: PBMC Isolation by Ficoll Gradient
pending.summary: Isolate PBMCs from human whole blood on Ficoll-Paque (1.077 g/mL): dilute 1:1, layer, spin 400 × g for 30 min with the brake off, harvest the interface, wash, count, and optionally cryopreserve.
pending.keywords: PBMC Ficoll density gradient centrifugation human blood mononuclear cells lymphocytes monocytes isolation cryopreservation

pending.title: Silver Staining of Protein Gels
